lq.ANSWER:
#include <stdio.h>

#include <stdlib.h>

 

// Define the structure for a contact node

struct Contact {

    int phoneNumber;

    struct Contact* next;

};

 

// Insert contact manually at the beginning

void insertManual(struct Contact** head, int phone) {

    struct Contact* newNode = (struct Contact*)malloc(sizeof(struct Contact));

    newNode->phoneNumber = phone;

    newNode->next = *head;

    *head = newNode;

    printf("Manually added contact: %d\n", phone);

}

 

// Insert imported contact at the end

void insertImported(struct Contact** head, int phone) {

    struct Contact* newNode = (struct Contact*)malloc(sizeof(struct Contact));

    newNode->phoneNumber = phone;

    newNode->next = NULL;

 

    if (*head == NULL) {

        *head = newNode;

    } else {

        struct Contact* temp = *head;

        while (temp->next != NULL)

            temp = temp->next;

        temp->next = newNode;

    }

    printf("Imported contact: %d\n", phone);

}

 

// Display all contacts

void viewContacts(struct Contact* head) {

    if (head == NULL) {

        printf("No contacts to display.\n");

        return;

    }

 

    printf("Contact List:\n");

    while (head != NULL) {

        printf("Phone: %d\n", head->phoneNumber);

        head = head->next;

    }

}

 

// Search for a contact by phone number

void searchContact(struct Contact* head, int key) {

    int position = 1;

    while (head != NULL) {

        if (head->phoneNumber == key) {

            printf("Contact %d found at position %d.\n", key, position);

            return;

        }

        head = head->next;

        position++;

    }

    printf("Contact %d not found.\n", key);

}

 

// Main driver code

int main() {

    struct Contact* head = NULL;

 

    insertManual(&head, 9876543210);

    insertImported(&head, 1234567890);

    insertManual(&head, 9988776655);

    insertImported(&head, 1122334455);

 

    viewContacts(head);

 

    searchContact(head, 1234567890);

    searchContact(head, 9999999999);

 

    return 0;

}

lq.QUESTION_DESC:
Consider you are building a lightweight contact manager for a feature phone. The contacts are stored in a singly linked list, where each node contains the contact's phone number (integer).The requirements are:

  • When a new contact is saved manually, it is added to the beginning of the list.
  • When a contact is imported from another device, it is added to the end of the list.
  • Users should be able to view all contacts.
  • Users should be able to search for a contact by phone number. Implement a C program that performs these operations using a singly linked list.
